slo_title: Explain the deadlock system model with resource allocation graphs

mcq.q: In the system model of a deadlock, the typical sequence in which a process uses resources is:
Which of the following is a valid example of a deadlock ?

options.A: Process finishes and frees all resources
options.B: Two processes each waiting for a resource held by the other
options.C: One process holds multiple resources and finishes without waiting
options.D: System with a single process and no competition

mcq.answer_text: Two processes each waiting for a resource held by the other

mcq.q: In the circular wait condition, which of the following holds true?

options.A: One process requests multiple resources at once
options.C: Each process waits for a resource held by another in a circular fashion
options.D: Each process releases all resources before requesting new ones

mcq.answer_text: Each process waits for a resource held by another in a circular fashion

mcq.q: Which of the following conditions is not necessary for a deadlock to occur?
What does no preemption mean in the context of deadlock?

options.A: A process can forcibly take another's resource
options.C: A resource can only be released voluntarily by the process holding it

mcq.answer_text: A resource can only be released voluntarily by the process holding it
